name: Dara Sok
headline: 62, former logistics director, night inventory supervisor, Vancouver
description: After thirty years running a logistics company in Phnom Penh, Dara moved to Vancouver to join their adult daughter. They now work part-time as a night inventory supervisor at a port warehouse, partly to stay busy and partly to learn a new city by walking through it. They keep the same 5 a.m. rice porridge ritual and never miss a Sunday remittance to their brother.
